name: Model-Based Policy Optimization (MBPO)
summary: Use short learned-model rollouts to generate extra training data for reinforcement learning policies.
summary_zh: 使用从真实数据出发的短模型滚动轨迹，在控制模型偏差的同时提升训练样本效率。
core_idea: Shorten model-generated rollout horizons to reduce compounding dynamics-model bias.
innovation: Balances model usage and policy learning to improve some model-based RL sample-efficiency regimes.
limitations: Still depends on sufficient true-environment coverage.
Predictive rollout reliability under unseen clinical interventions is unproven.

start_here.why: NeurIPS source motivating short model-generated rollouts.
start_here.focus: Model bias, rollout horizon and real-data branching.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
